rules.title: Fair Chance Ordinance: limits on using arrest and conviction history in affordable housing
rules.requirement: In San Francisco affordable housing, housing providers are limited in how they can use an applicant's arrest or conviction history when deciding on an application. If you think your record was used improperly, you can contact the San Francisco Human Rights Commission.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applicants for and residents of affordable housing in San Francisco who have an arrest or conviction history. The rule applies only to affordable housing, not to all rentals.
rules.citation: S.F. Police Code art. 49 (Fair Chance Ordinance)

unresolvable_conditions: Housing must be affordable housing (subsidized or income-restricted), which an assessor record does not show

rules.reason: Single official-source candidate describing San Francisco's Fair Chance Ordinance as applied to affordable housing; kept as its own record with the affordable-housing limit as an unresolvable coverage condition.
